# Summary
Part of the batch of 13 blog topic ideas drafted from the 49-post review on June 24-25 and saved to `blog-drafts\` (per the handoff: drafted, not published). Source: `blog-drafts\commercial-sewer-line-maintenance.md`. Each draft carries a focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta, slug, internal link list, image alt ideas and external sources.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyphrase:** commercial sewer line maintenance.
- **Status:** draft only; not in the July 21 live blog inventory, and no later publish record in this folder.
- Property manager guide: inspection schedules, warning signs, trenchless repair, planning. Commercial scope is unconfirmed by Scott; uses "pipelining" in an anchor. The content plan's guide #8 (commercial drain cleaning) is the newer version of this idea.
